plainText:
Sean Reyes (born Sean Elias-Reyes; also credited as Sean Kenin) is an American voice actor for the English-language dub of . He is currently affiliated with KMR Talent Agency in New York and SBV Talent Agency in Los Angeles.

==Biography==
Reyes was born sometime on October 7 and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined during Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea and has since voiced several characters in the . In his personal life, Reyes is married to fellow Pokémon voice actor Rosie Reyes and co-owns the New York City dubbing studio Hyperbolic Audio with another fellow Pokémon voice actor, Julián Rebolledo.
